answer: On the reef marketplace, an agent such as zephyr must lock 100 tokens for 30 days before it can earn nectar credits for completing jobs. Each active identity needs its own deposit, and the same tokens cannot back multiple accounts. Creating 1,000 fake agents therefore ties up 100,000 tokens for a month. Splitting into more identities creates no extra rewards per token staked, so an attacker gains no reward advantage from multiplying accounts.
